changelog resolves the base version and the signal floor, collects the
evidence of the commits since the base version (each commit's record and,
by default, its diff), has the configured producer author a structured
changelog from it, suggests the bump from the entries' kinds raised to the
signal floor, and answers with the version, the bump and the suggestion
with its reasons, where the authored changelog is kept, and the rendered
changelog section. It never prompts and confirms nothing: without a named
bump the section is a preview under the suggested bump. It writes
CHANGELOG.md only with --write, which requires a bump.

bump is major, minor or patch. A named bump below the suggestion proceeds
with a warning naming the entries that drove the suggestion; one below
the signal floor is refused unless --force is given. The authored
changelog is cached for the commit range, and reused until --redo-notes.
Exits 1 when no release is warranted.

Usage:
  release changelog [bump] [flags]

Flags:
      --corpus path     Read the corpus at this path instead of the cache when it exists, and write it there otherwise
      --force           Accept a named bump below the signal floor. Requires bump
  -h, --help            help for changelog
      --json            Render the answer as JSON instead of YAML
      --redo-notes      Discard any cached corpus and author again
      --skip-notes      Author with the mechanical producer instead of the configured one, and read no cache
      --target branch   The release line to collect from: a branch (default: the configured target, else the branch origin/HEAD points to)
      --write           Write the rendered section into CHANGELOG.md. Requires bump

Global Flags:
      --config file   Use this configuration file instead of discovering one
  -C, --repo path     Operate on the repository at this path instead of the working directory
